pr_checkout.fork_not_here: {pr} comes from a fork that isn't a remote here. Add the fork as a remote and fetch it to check out its branch.
pr_checkout.gone: That pull request is no longer listed.
pr_checkout.name_taken: The local branch {branch} neither tracks nor pushes to {remote}/{branch}, where {pr} comes from, so it may be another branch. Rename it to check out the pull request's branch.
